nodes.summary: Polynomial and product identities, sum-of-squares identities, functional equations on rings, and elementary operations on functions and sets.
nodes.title: Algebraic identities and operations

nodes.summary: Noncommutative rings and finite-dimensional associative algebras, including division and central simple algebras, quaternion algebras, polynomial identities, nil ideals and Hopf algebras. Group rings are under Group Theory.
nodes.title: Associative rings and algebras

nodes.summary: Lie algebras and their structure and representations, free Lie algebras, Poisson algebras, and racks and quandles.
nodes.title: Lie algebras and nonassociative structures

nodes.summary: Classical and combinatorial families of polynomials, their recurrences and generating functions, and orthogonality via Favard's theorem, J-fractions and Riordan arrays.
nodes.title: Orthogonal polynomials and polynomial sequences

nodes.summary: Univariate and multivariate polynomials and formal power series as algebraic objects: coefficients, derivations, symmetric polynomials, irreducibility, polynomial maps and rational series.
nodes.title: Polynomials and power series

nodes.summary: Location, counting and multiplicity of the zeros of polynomials: real-rootedness, stability, interlacing, root bounds and Sturm sequences.
nodes.title: Zeros of polynomials

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
